fields.name: role
fields.label: Role
fields.schema_description: Device role used to select network devices for deployment.
fields.query_param_normalization: Single value (searchParams.get('role'), ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:99). Matched against option key (role name) and mapped to the option value; an unmatched value gives "" (ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:67-76, 119). Re-applied until the first manual change.
client_only_validation: Choices limited to roles with managed devices (managed_only=true). The schema accepts any string.

fields.name: max_batch_size
fields.label: Max Batch Size
fields.schema_description: Maximum number of devices included in each deployment batch.
fields.query_param_normalization: Number.parseInt(value, 10), applied only when 1..100; any other value resets to 10 (ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:100, 127-134).
client_only_validation: z.coerce.number().min(1) 'Batch size must be at least 1' (ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:47-49).
max(100) 'Batch size cannot exceed 100' (ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:50). The schema has no minimum or maximum.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.schema_description: Location used to filter the selected network devices.

options.notes: useEnvData requests /v1/parameter/location?location_type=Site&location_type=Module (ui/src/hooks/useEnvData.ts:34-41); the repeated location_type key is an array, which v1 OptionSource.params (scalar values only) cannot express. Rows are mapped by mapLocationOptions (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:25-36): label = name, value = 'dcim-location:' + JSON [location_type, id] when the row has a location_type, otherwise the bare id. The encoded value is UI-only and is decoded back to id + location_type before use (ui/src/lib/location-options.ts:39-59).

fields.query_param_normalization: Single value (searchParams.get('location'), ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:101). Resolved by resolveLocationFormValue against option value (encoded), provider id, or display name, first match wins; unmatched gives "" (ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:120-123). The param is 'location', unlike 'site' on the other forms. multiDeployWorkflowForm.spec.ts:207-240 checks that a name in the URL submits the id.
fields.submit_transform: resolveLocationOption(siteData, data.location)?.id ?? (data.location?.trim() || null): the decoded provider id, or null when empty (ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:156, 160).

fields.name: status
fields.label: Device Status
fields.schema_description: Device statuses used to filter the selected network devices.
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (searchParams.getAll('status'), ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:102). Values are kept only if they equal an option key (status name); there is no default fallback (ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:79-89, 124).

fields.name: tenant
fields.label: Tenant
fields.schema_description: Tenant used to filter the selected network devices.
fields.query_param_normalization: Single value (searchParams.get('tenant'), ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:103). Matched against option key (tenant name); an unmatched value gives "" (ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:67-76, 125).

fields.name: commit_confirm
fields.label: Use commit-confirm
fields.description: Rollback if device becomes unreachable after apply. Disable for changes that are expected to interrupt connectivity.
fields.schema_description: Whether to use commit-confirmed mode when the platform supports it.

fields.name: location_type
fields.schema_description: DCIM location type for the location identifier.
fields.submit_transform: location_type of the selected location option (ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:156, 161); undefined, so omitted from the JSON, when the option has no type or no location is chosen. The server pairs it with location by the '<field>_type' naming convention (src/nv_config_manager/temporal/api/workflow_submission.py:163-168).

payload_transform: onSubmit (ui/src/app/workflows/multideployworkflow/form/multi-deploy-workflow-form.tsx:153-177) builds {role, max_batch_size: data.max_batch_size || 10, location: <decoded id> | null, location_type: <decoded type> | undefined, status: <array> | null, tenant: <trimmed> | null, commit_confirm: data.commit_confirm ?? true} in that key order. JSON.stringify drops location_type when it is undefined. The body is POSTed through startWorkflow('/v1/workflow/ngc/multi_deploy') (ui/src/lib/utils.tsx:153-184), which navigates to /workflows/{id}. Errors produce a destructive toast and reset isSubmitting. multiDeployWorkflowForm.spec.ts:82-89, 128-135, 239 and 301-308 assert the body (mock locations have no location_type).
discrepancies: max_batch_size is limited to 1..100 only in the client. The schema has an unbounded integer with default 10.
Role choices are limited to managed roles. The schema accepts any string.
An empty location, status or tenant is sent as null, which matches the schema defaults. location_type is omitted rather than sent as null.
The URL param for location is 'location', whereas the other location forms use 'site'.
Playwright never exercises encoded location values or location_type (ui/src/mocks/data/formData.ts:26-39).
contract_gaps: site_reference on location has to fill the sibling field location_type from the selected option (src/nv_config_manager/temporal/api/workflow_submission.py:163-168). v1 cannot declare a widget that writes a second field, or hide location_type, so a generic form would render location_type as a free-text nullable field.
OptionSource.params is scalar-only (location_type=Site&location_type=Module), and the location value is a UI-encoded composite (dcim-location:[location_type,id]).
The client-only max_batch_size range 1..100 has no v1 hint. Expressing it needs schema ge/le, which is out of scope.
Query prefill coercion and normalization (parseInt with range fallback, multi-value status, matching by option key) cannot be expressed. UiHint.query_param is just a name.
location, location_type, status and tenant are anyOf[T, null], so the renderer needs a nullable rule, including for anyOf[array[string], null].
